props.name: title
props.description: A short title naming what the actions apply to.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence under the title, for example the consequence of the critical action.

props.name: actions
props.description: The actions, most used first.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The label of the button that closes without acting. Defaults to Cancel.

props.name: preview
props.description: Draws it in place, open and not modal, inside its parent: for documentation, previews and screenshots, never in a product flow.

props.name: ratio
props.description: `square` 1:1, `photo` 4:3, `video` 16:9 (default), `portrait` 3:4, `wide` 21:9.

props.name: name
props.description: Person or brand the avatar stands for. Used as the accessible name and for the initials.

props.name: src
props.description: Photo URL. Omitted (or failing to load) = initials from `name`.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` 30px for post headers, `md` 44px for lists, `lg` 84px on a soft shadow for profile headers.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Set when a visible name sits right next to the avatar, so screen readers don't hear it twice.

props.name: tone
props.description: `neutral` is a word alone. `info`, `positive`, `warning` and `critical` add their own glyph shape (circle, check, triangle, octagon) in the tone colour, so colour is never the only cue.

props.name: dot
props.description: Neutral only. A leading dot in the secondary text colour, for a status with no tone such as Draft.

props.name: children
props.description: The status in words, such as "Live", "3 new" or "Failed".

props.name: tone
props.description: The tone. Each has its own glyph shape (circle, check, triangle, octagon) and its spoken word, so colour is never the only cue.

props.name: title
props.description: One line saying what happened.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional detail saying what it means or what to do. Shown under the title.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional action at the end of the line, normally a quiet Button. Use the loud solid only when acting on this message is the pane's main task.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a Dismiss button. Called after the line has closed, so remove the banner from state here.

props.name: live
props.description:
Announce it when it appears. 'polite' gives role="status" and 'assertive' gives role="alert".
Leave it unset for banners already present on page load, since announcing those interrupts for nothing.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding on every side, from the gap scale. Defaults to none.

props.name: paddingInline
props.description: Padding on the inline sides only; overrides `padding` there.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.description: Padding on the block sides only; overrides `padding` there.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner from the shape scale: `inner` for a surface inside a pane, `media` for an image, `round` for a pill.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Defaults to div.

props.name: variant
props.description: `light` = the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light), the one main action on a pane. `accent` = the same solid glowing with its own light, for a promoted action. `glass` = quiet glass lit from above.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` = 44px tall (default, touch-friendly); `sm` = 32px for dense rows and toolbars.

props.name: variant
props.description: `glass` = a floating pane. `inset` = content nested inside a pane (no second glass layer, top divider).

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered element. Use `article` for self-contained content, `section` for a titled region, `aside` for complementary content and `header` for a page head.

props.name: level
props.description: Where the pane sits in the stack: 1 a pane on the scene (default), 2 a surface inside a pane, 3 an overlay such as a dialog, 4 a popover. A Card inside a Card is level 2 without being told.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL; omit for a decorative gradient placeholder.

props.name: inline
props.description: Centres inline content (an icon beside text) without taking a full row.

props.name: label
props.description: The choice in words. Clicking it toggles the box, and it is the box's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary line under the label.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. `'indeterminate'` shows a dash for a parent of mixed children.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the control off, so it cannot be focused or changed. Inside a FormField, its `disabled` sets this for you.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the answer as required for form submission and for assistive tech.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted when checked. Defaults to "on".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the outer element.

props.name: children
props.description: The chip's label, which is also its accessible name.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selection (filter chips). Selection is carried by aria-pressed and a check mark, never colour alone.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initial selection when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the new selection.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Makes it an input chip with a remove button named "Remove {label}".

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Plain-text label for the remove button's name, when children is not plain text.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width. sm is 640px, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1200 (the default) and 2xl 1440.

props.name: trigger

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's title, its accessible name.

props.name: description

props.name: children
props.description: The body.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the foot, the loud action last. Wrap a button in `Dialog.Close` to close on press.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when it opens or closes.

props.name: size

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the dialog pane.

props.name: preview
props.description: Draws it in place, open and not modal, inside its parent: for documentation, previews and screenshots, never in a product flow.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` (default) runs across a column; `vertical` stands between items in a row.

props.name: inset
props.description: Insets the line from both ends by the content inset, so it aligns with text instead of the pane's edge.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hides the line from assistive technology when it only decorates (the default is a separator).

props.name: side

props.name: preview

props.name: brightness
props.description:
How bright the world behind the glass is (D-009). Glass inside darkens to keep text ≥4.5:1.
Size it for the brightest spot a card can land on, not the scene's average. Default `bright`.

props.name: material
props.description:
`glass` (default) blurs and dims the scene behind every pane. `solid` swaps every pane inside for the
opaque surface and turns the backdrop filter off (D-021), for a live backdrop such as a 3D scene or
video, where re-blurring each frame costs the frame rate. Text contrast is the same measured fallback
used for reduced transparency.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon.

props.name: label
props.description: The action's name. Shown beside the icon when `extended`; otherwise it is the accessible name.

props.name: extended
props.description: Shows the label beside the icon, for the first visit or a wide screen.

props.name: position
props.description: `fixed` (default) floats over the viewport at the bottom end; `contained` floats in its nearest positioned parent.

props.name: legend
props.description: The group's name, read before every control in it.

props.name: help
props.description: Optional help for the whole group, under the legend.

props.name: direction

props.name: gap

props.name: align
props.description: Cross-axis alignment: `stretch`, `start`, `center` (default), `end`, `baseline`.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Lets children wrap to a new line when they do not fit.

props.description: Override the column count. By default it follows the layout tokens, which give 4, then 8 at md (768px), then 12 at lg (1024px).

props.name: start
props.description: Shown before the input inside the same well, such as a search icon or a currency. Decorative unless it is a control.

props.name: end

props.name: rotate
props.description: Turns the pools around the centre, in degrees, to move where the light seems to come from.
